text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is approaching, and Matikanefukukitaru's worries over her first long-distance race begin to mount.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Concerned for her, Silence Suzuka offers some words of encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her eyes, Matikanefukukitaru is a lot more amazing than she believes. Suzuka tells her to have a bit more confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gaining courage from those words, Matikanefukukitaru vows to focus on the Kikuka Sho with a new, positive mindset.
